text:
Lia: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — proposed owners/timelines for the testing/evals work that came out of the incident. TL;DR: we need (1) prompt set for the truncation/regression class, (2) regression harness + CI gating, (3) load test that reproduces the burst sequence, (4) chaos drill + updated runbook. I'll start a tracking doc but please drop owners & rough estimates here.

Ben: Ack. I can own the prompt-set and the regression test cases. Rough estimate 2w to curate + add to eval runner.

Sanjay: I can take the load test harness. Need an infra slot and a small sandbox to iterate on traffic patterns — estimate 1w once infra is available.

Emma: I'll own the chaos drill and runbook updates. Suggest a staged drill (canary -> partial -> full) and a tabletop before live runs. Plan ~1.5w including documentation.

Anne: I can gate the CI integration and add the regression suite to the presubmit matrix, but I need the test runner to be containerized and a stable artifact to pull.

Lia: Great — mapping to action items:
- Prompt set (failure class: token truncation + truncation-adjacent hallucination) — owner: Ben — 2w
- Regression harness + CI gate (presubmit + nightly) — owner: Anne — 1w to wire once artifacts ready
- Load test (burst at sequence boundary) — owner: Sanjay — 1w once infra assigned
- Chaos drill + runbook updates — owner: Emma — 1.5w

Ben: putting initial checklist here:
```
promptset/truncation/
  - seed-cases: 120
  - edge-cases: 40 (long context, injected stops, streaming)
  - acceptance: <=1% truncation per 1k tokens
```
I'll open a PR against the evals repo today with the first 50 seeds.

Sanjay: sample load command I'll start from to reproduce the pattern: 
```
ab -n 10000 -c 250 -T 'application/json' -p payload.json https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate
```
I'll try to capture the exact token distribution we saw.

Lia: For tracking: I'll create a single issue in our postmortem board that lists each action item, owners, and deadlines. Can everyone add the specific sub-tasks to that issue when Ben creates the prompt PR and Sanjay creates the load harness repo? I'll assign weekly check-ins (15m) until items are done.

Anne: One dependency note — CI runner needs an ephemeral model artifact with determinism flags enabled (quantized variant caused some non-determinism in yesterday's replay). Can research/infra produce a pinned docker image for the eval runs? @DevOps-bot can you capture?

DevOps-bot: Created infra ticket INF-5743 to provision sandbox GPU infra for load/chaos testing and to snapshot the model artifact. ETA: 3 business days.

Ben: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/evals/pulls/312 — contains first 50 prompt seeds + README for how to run locally. Feedback welcome. :point_up: I'll add expected metrics in the PR description.

Emma: I'll draft the tabletop exercise doc and post it to the runbooks channel. Couple questions: do we want ops on the first canary run, or treat it as ops-observed only?

Lia: ops should be on-call for the first canary. Anne — can you add the presubmit gating rule to block merges if regression metric regressed > 3%? That gives us an early stop.

Anne: Yes, I can add the gating rule once the eval runner exposes the metric endpoint (prometheus scrape). Need Ben to add an endpoint in the evals PR.

Ben: Will add /metrics and a short exporter in the PR today.

Sanjay: Noted on infra ticket INF-5743. Once sandbox is ready I'll push the harness and a sample replay script.

Lia: Thanks all — action summary I will paste into the issue: owners + estimates + infra ticket link + PR link. Expecting first check-in next Tuesday. If anyone needs to shift timelines call it out here. :calendar:

Ben: :thumbsup:

Emma: :raised_hands:

Anne: I'll follow up on gating and add the presubmit checklist.

Lia: Closing the loop — I'll assign owners in the issue and ping next steps after the PR/infra are linked. Thanks!
